name: claude-review
description: Review Codex turns with Claude on Stop. Inverse of openai/codex-plugin-cc.

interface.shortDescription: Claude (Opus 4.7) reviews every Codex turn on Stop and requests rework when needed.
interface.longDescription: Codex CLI plugin that invokes Claude as a stop-time reviewer. On every Codex Stop event, the plugin sends the last Codex response to Claude for a read-only critique. If Claude responds BLOCK, Codex receives the critique as a new user prompt and continues working; if ALLOW, the session stops normally. Mirrors the architecture of openai/codex-plugin-cc in reverse.
